label: Hourly Sync (APD/FireSmoke/Face)
info:
Pushes completed hours from apd_hourly/firesmoke_hourly/face_hourly (local site DB, env-admin) into traffic_countings (server utama, env-iot) — same pattern as the existing inout_resample sync, adapted for tables that don't have a surrogate id column (device_id+hour_start is the natural key everywhere here) and that share the target table with the person-counting sync (so writes MERGE into the existing JSONB `data` column instead of replacing it — see the 'build INSERT' nodes).

Assumes this is imported into the SAME Node-RED instance that already has the 'FETCH/SERVER UTAMA/UPDATE LOCAL' postgreSQLConfig nodes configured (ids f973403dd55782d0 / 4399a9fce6b51683 in the existing inout_resample flow) — if importing elsewhere, re-point the postgresql nodes below at your own DB config nodes first.

name: query
func:
msg.query = `
  SELECT *
  FROM apd_hourly
  WHERE is_synced = false
  AND hour_start < date_trunc('hour', NOW())
  LIMIT 800
`;
return msg;
